title: BcProvisionInput
description: Provision a scanned device. Only `barcode` is required; placement and toggles are optional. `new_location` / `new_page` create their target on demand (and are used in preference to `location_id` / `page_id` when present). `tenant_id` is bound by the host and cannot be supplied.

barcode.description: Raw barcode string to decode and provision.

site_id.description: Existing site to place the device under.

location_id.description: Existing location to place the device under.

new_location.description: Create a location on demand and place the device under it.

page_id.description: Existing page to hang the device's widgets on.

new_page.description: Create a page on demand and hang the device's widgets on it.

name.description: Override the device display name (defaults to the template name).

trend.description: Enable trending on the template's trend-eligible points.
